note: Read-only inference-time dissection of the four slot-attention collapse rings on one frozen original fold0/seed3 checkpoint. Arms differ ONLY in which single ring of the native MultiHeadSlotAttention forward is ablated. No optimizer, no parameter update, no source edit; third_party/SlotSPE is untouched. Primary readout is per-iteration cross-slot divergence and pairwise cosine, NOT C-index. Only --run executes.
scope: Mechanism localization only. Not a predictive-harm claim, not correction efficacy, not a performance comparison.
required_preconditions: the 'none' arm must reproduce the recorded historical validation logits at eval_seed within 1e-6
the trained state digest must be identical before and after every arm
